questions.question: King Josiah of Judah commanded all the people to keep which feast of the LORD?
Of all the kings before and after him, there was no king like Josiah of Judah, who turned to the LORD with all his heart. True or false?
After all the good King Josiah did, the LORD turned away from His burning anger against Judah. True or false?
Even after King Josiah's reforms, what had the LORD said He would do with Judah?

answers.text: Remove Judah from His sight as He did Israel
Give Judah rest from all its enemies
Spare Judah forever because of Josiah
